selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What did the traveler want to do next in his search to know Allah better?
questions.answer: He wanted to enter the human world and learn more there.

questions.question: Which group especially called him into that realm?
questions.answer: The prophets especially called him there.

questions.question: What did the prophets use to support their message?
questions.answer: They were given many miracles as signs that their message was true.

questions.question: What does the passage say was one purpose of the prophets’ teaching work?
questions.answer: It was to lift people to a better and more heavenly level.

questions.question: Why did the traveler see the prophets as very trustworthy teachers?
questions.answer: Allah gave them miracles, and many honest people accepted their message.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention that many people believed through the prophets?
questions.answer: It shows their message changed lives and was accepted by truthful people.

questions.question: How were believers described in contrast to those who reject the truth?
questions.answer: They were described as truthful and righteous.

questions.question: What do the prophets’ strong faith and sacrifice teach us about them?
questions.answer: They show that the prophets were sincere and truthful.

questions.question: What does believing in all the prophets add to a Muslim’s faith?
questions.answer: It gives faith extra strength and support.

questions.question: What did the traveler gain from the lesson about all the prophets being part of faith?
questions.answer: He gained greater strength in his iman.

questions.question: In this passage, whose world did the traveler enter after moving forward in knowledge of Allah?
questions.answer: He entered the world of human beings.

questions.question: Where did he go to continue this journey?
questions.answer: He went into the human realm.

questions.question: Why were the prophets able to call people strongly to belief in Allah?
questions.answer: They had many clear miracles proving their mission.

questions.question: How did they help people move upward spiritually?
questions.answer: They taught people and invited them to faith.

questions.question: Who gave the prophets their miracles?
questions.answer: The Creator of everything gave them those signs.

questions.question: Why is the witness of many truthful people important in understanding the prophets’ message?
questions.answer: Because shared testimony from honest people makes the message very reliable.

questions.question: What good quality became clearer to the traveler when he saw people accept the truth?
questions.answer: He saw more clearly how noble and holy true belief is.

questions.question: What are some signs of the prophets’ honesty besides miracles?
questions.answer: Their noble character, truthful teaching, strong faith, and self-sacrifice.

questions.question: How did the students of the prophets become evidence for the truth of the prophets’ path?
questions.answer: By following them and reaching truth and spiritual growth, they showed the path was real.

questions.question: Why can’t weak doubt stand against the proof described in this passage?
questions.answer: Because the proof is supported by many signs, many prophets, and many truthful followers.

questions.question: What new stage of learning did the traveler enter in this part of the passage?
questions.answer: He entered a stage of learning from the prophets within the world of humanity.

questions.question: Into which part of creation did he enter in this passage?
questions.answer: He entered the world of people.

questions.question: What was one reason their message had such strong force?
questions.answer: Their message was backed by many clear miracles.

questions.question: What helped prove that their message was not just a claim?
questions.answer: Their many miracles proved it.
